name: Maid-san
source: A Maid-san type monster girl. This Maid-san serves a hanni out in the woods. Since she has no formal attachment to the hanni that she serves [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url] is able to tame her as his own. Afterward she serves Leo to the best of her ability in everything that a proper maid should serve her master in even if Leo is embarrassed about it.
